title: Wavelet Flow Matching for Time Series
abstract: arXiv:2609.39374v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Synthetic time series are increasingly used for data augmentation, privacy-preserving data sharing, and downstream model development, yet faithfully reproducing both multi-scale temporal structure and cross-channel dependencies remains challenging. We study multivariate time-series generation through flow matching in the wavelet domain. By operating on multilevel discrete wavelet coefficients rather than directly in the time domain, the model represents coarse structure and progressively finer details at separate scales. Their naturally different variances further induce an implicit coarse-to-fine generative process without requiring an explicit multi-scale schedule. Since the transform acts independently on each channel, we pair it with a channel-token transformer whose attention directly models cross-channel dependencies. translated_title: 面向时间序列的小波流匹配
translated_abstract: 合成时间序列越来越多地被用于数据增强、隐私保护的数据共享以及下游模型开发，然而如何忠实地再现多尺度时间结构与跨通道依赖关系仍然是一个挑战。我们研究了在小波域中通过流匹配进行多元时间序列生成的方法。通过在多级离散小波系数上进行操作，而非直接在时域中建模，该模型能够在不同尺度上分别表示粗粒度结构和逐渐精细的细节。这些系数天然不同的方差进一步诱导出一种隐式的从粗到细的生成过程，无需显式的多尺度调度。由于小波变换独立作用于每个通道，我们将其与通道标记Transformer相结合，利用其注意力机制直接建模跨通道依赖关系。在七个基准数据集和四种序列长度的实验中，我们的方法在大多数数据集-指标组合上表现最佳或持平。
tldr: 该论文提出在小波域中进行流匹配的多元时间序列生成方法，利用多级离散小波系数天然不同的方差实现隐式的从粗到细生成过程，并配合通道标记Transformer直接建模跨通道依赖，在七个基准数据集上取得了最佳或持平的表现。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes flow matching in the wavelet domain for multivariate time series generation, where multilevel discrete wavelet coefficients with naturally different variances induce an implicit coarse-to-fine generative process, paired with a channel-token transformer that directly models cross-channel dependencies, achieving best or tied performance across seven benchmark datasets.
